jobs.summary: group security engineering for a uk financial product on aws. senior jun 2025, lead jun 2026.

bullets: killed static credentials: irsa/oidc, iam database auth with sbu isolation, github app installation tokens.
hardened argocd, helm and iac. no more cluster-admin in ci. sbom/cve generation on the path that actually ships.
github org governance as code: privileged access inventory, production merge gates, zero shadow admins.
serverless sast on cloudflare workers with opengrep and llm triage, plus cloudtrail detections into slack and an internal trail explorer.
set the security-by-design baseline: iam, zero-trust network, iac, vulnerability slas. architecture reviews before the merge, not after the audit.
run cspm and incident response: guardduty and cloudtrail triage, forensic timelines, executive briefs, mitigation runbooks.
authorized internal vapt and secure code review. hop on the debugging call, patch with the engineer, retest, close the sla.
technical authority for customer audits and due diligence. map live controls to evidence, not a slide.
